props.name: sun
props.sand3dProgram:
import sand3d as s3d

def build():
    # Sun body - a sphere
    sun = s3d.sphere("sun", 120)
    
    # Sun rays - triangular shapes extruded from the sphere
    ray_profile = s3d.poly([(0, 0), (15, 0), (20, 10), (15, 20), (0, 20)])
    rays = []
    for angle in range(0, 360, 30):
        frame = s3d.Frame((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), (1, 0, 0)).turn(rz=angle)
        ray = s3d.extrude("ray", ray_profile, 60, on=frame)
        rays.append(s3d.at(ray, on=s3d.bbox(sun, "+Z")))
    
    # Combine sun and rays
    s3d.join(sun, *rays)
    
    # Add a simple face to make it recognizable
    eye1 = s3d.at(s3d.sphere("eye1", 15), x=-30, y=-20, z=30)
    eye2 = s3d.at(s3d.sphere("eye2", 15), x=30, y=-20, z=30)
    mouth = s3d.at(s3d.cylinder("mouth", 40, 10, d2=20), x=0, y=30, z=30, rx=90)
    
    s3d.join(sun, eye1, eye2, mouth)
    
    # Add a stand to make it hand-held
    stand = s3d.at(s3d.box("stand", 20, 20, 100), x=0, y=0, z=-100)
    s3d.join(sun, stand)
    
    return sun

if __name__ == "__main__":
    s3d.export(build(), "sun.glb")

props.name: honeycomb
props.sand3dProgram:
import sand3d as s3d

def build():
    # Create hexagonal cells
    def hex_cell(d):
        points = []
        for i in range(6):
            angle = i * 60
            x = d * 0.5 * s3d.math.cos(s3d.math.radians(angle))
            y = d * 0.5 * s3d.math.sin(s3d.math.radians(angle))
            points.append((x, y))
        return s3d.poly(points)

    # Build honeycomb pattern
    cell = s3d.extrude("cell", hex_cell(20), 15)
    honeycomb = s3d.assembly("honeycomb")
    
    # Arrange cells in honeycomb pattern
    rows = 4
    cols = 5
    for row in range(rows):
        for col in range(cols):
            # Offset every other row
            x_offset = 17.32 if row % 2 == 1 else 0
            x = col * 34.64 + x_offset
            y = row * 30
            honeycomb.attach("cell", s3d.at(s3d.copy(cell), x=x, y=y))

    # Add honey droplet
    droplet = s3d.at(s3d.sphere("droplet", 12), x=0, y=-40, z=5)
    s3d.material(droplet, "glossy_plastic", color="#FFD700", opacity=0.8)
    honeycomb.attach("droplet", droplet)

    # Add handle
    handle = s3d.at(s3d.box("handle", 60, 10, 5), x=0, y=-60, z=20)
    s3d.material(handle, "wood", color="#8B4513")
    honeycomb.attach("handle", handle)

    return honeycomb

if __name__ == "__main__":
    s3d.export(build(), "honeycomb.glb")

props.name: pesticide sprayer
props.sand3dProgram:
import sand3d as s3d

def build():
    # Main tank body
    tank = s3d.extrude("tank", s3d.rect(40, 60, r=8), 80)
    
    # Nozzle attachment
    nozzle_base = s3d.at(s3d.cylinder("nozzle_base", 20, 15), on=tank.face("+Z"), z=80)
    
    # Nozzle tip
    nozzle = s3d.extrude("nozzle", s3d.rect(10, 15), 30)
    s3d.at(nozzle, on=nozzle_base.face("+Z"), x=-5, y=0)
    
    # Spray trigger
    trigger = s3d.at(s3d.box("trigger", 30, 8, 15), on=tank.face("-X"), x=-40, y=0, z=40)
    s3d.fillet(trigger, 2, edges="+Y-Z +Y+Z")
    
    # Handle
    handle = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("handle", s3d.rect(25, 15, r=5), 50), on=tank.face("-X"), x=-40, y=0, z=60)
    s3d.fillet(handle, 3, edges="top")
    
    # Pressure pump
    pump = s3d.at(s3d.cylinder("pump", 25, 30), on=tank.face("-X"), x=-40, y=0, z=30)
    s3d.fillet(pump, 2, edges="top bottom")
    
    # Assembly
    sprayer = s3d.assembly("pesticide_sprayer", tank, nozzle_base, nozzle, trigger, handle, pump)
    return sprayer

if __name__ == "__main__":
    s3d.export(build(), "pesticide_sprayer.glb")

props.name: tractor
props.sand3dProgram:
import sand3d as s3d

def build():
    # Main body
    body = s3d.extrude("body", s3d.rect(120, 60, r=8), 40)
    
    # Cab
    cab = s3d.at(s3d.box("cab", 50, 40, 35), x=-20, y=10, z=40)
    
    # Hood
    hood = s3d.at(s3d.box("hood", 40, 35, 25), x=20, y=12.5, z=15)
    
    # Wheels
    front_wheel = s3d.at(s3d.cylinder("front_wheel", 25, 8), x=-40, y=0, z=8)
    rear_wheel = s3d.at(s3d.cylinder("rear_wheel", 35, 10), x=40, y=0, z=10)
    
    # Steering wheel
    steering = s3d.at(s3d.cylinder("steering", 8, 5), on=cab.face("front"), z=10)
    
    # Exhaust stack
    exhaust = s3d.at(s3d.cylinder("exhaust", 6, 15), x=30, y=0, z=40)
    
    # Combine all parts
    tractor = s3d.assembly("tractor", body, cab, hood, front_wheel, rear_wheel, steering, exhaust)
    
    return tractor

if __name__ == "__main__":
    s3d.export(build(), "tractor.glb")

props.name: cloud
props.sand3dProgram:
import sand3d as s3d

def build():
    # Main cloud body - soft puffy shape
    cloud_body = s3d.extrude("cloud_body", s3d.poly([(0, 0), (60, 0), (80, 20), (60, 40), (30, 50), (0, 40), (-20, 20)], fillet=8), 20)
    
    # Add smaller cloud bumps for texture
    bump1 = s3d.at(s3d.sphere("bump1", 25), x=-30, y=15, z=10)
    bump2 = s3d.at(s3d.sphere("bump2", 20), x=40, y=-10, z=15)
    bump3 = s3d.at(s3d.sphere("bump3", 18), x=20, y=30, z=5)
    
    # Assemble the cloud
    cloud = s3d.group("cloud", cloud_body, bump1, bump2, bump3)
    
    # Add a simple handle for holding
    handle = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("handle", s3d.rect(10, 40), 30), on=s3d.bbox(cloud, "-Z"), z=25)
    s3d.fillet(handle, 2, edges="all")
    
    # Final assembly with handle
    cloud_prop = s3d.assembly("cloud_prop", cloud, handle)
    
    # Apply a soft white material
    s3d.material(cloud_prop, "glossy_plastic", color="#f0f8ff", opacity=0.9)
    s3d.material(handle, "plastic", color="#dcdcdc")
    
    return cloud_prop

if __name__ == "__main__":
    s3d.export(build(), "cloud.glb")

props.name: wilted flower
props.sand3dProgram:
import sand3d as s3d

def build():
    # Stem
    stem = s3d.extrude("stem", s3d.rect(4, 4), 80)
    stem = s3d.transform(stem, ry=15)
    
    # Wilted petals
    petal = s3d.extrude("petal", s3d.ellipse(20, 10), 2)
    petal = s3d.transform(petal, ry=30)
    
    # Flower head assembly
    flower_head = s3d.group("flower_head")
    for i in range(5):
        angle = i * 72
        petal_rotated = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(petal), rz=angle)
        petal_rotated = s3d.at(petal_rotated, z=2)
        s3d.join(flower_head, petal_rotated)
    
    # Center
    center = s3d.sphere("center", 8)
    s3d.join(flower_head, center)
    
    # Attach flower head to stem
    s3d.attach(stem, "flower_head", s3d.at(flower_head, on=stem.face("top")))
    
    # Base
    base = s3d.extrude("base", s3d.rect(40, 40, r=5), 5)
    s3d.join(base, stem)
    
    return s3d.assembly("wilted_flower", base)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    s3d.export(build(), "out.glb")

props.name: droplet
props.sand3dProgram:
import sand3d as s3d

def build():
    # Main droplet body
    droplet = s3d.revolve("droplet", [(0, 0), (0, 40), (30, 60), (60, 60), (60, 0)], angle=360)
    
    # Add a small base for stability
    base = s3d.extrude("base", s3d.rect(70, 70, r=5), 5)
    s3d.at(base, z=-2.5)
    
    # Combine droplet and base
    s3d.join(droplet, base)
    
    # Add a small hole for hanging
    s3d.hole(droplet, 3, on=s3d.bbox(droplet, "+Y-Z"))
    
    return droplet

if __name__ == "__main__":
    s3d.export(build(), "droplet.glb")

props.name: ladybug
props.sand3dProgram:
import sand3d as s3d

def build():
    # Ladybug body (red sphere)
    body = s3d.sphere("body", 30)
    s3d.material(body, kind="plastic", color="#cc0000", roughness=0.3)
    
    # Ladybug head (smaller sphere)
    head = s3d.sphere("head", 15)
    s3d.material(head, kind="plastic", color="#cc0000", roughness=0.3)
    s3d.at(head, on=body.face("+Z"), x=15)
    
    # Eyes (black spheres)
    eye = s3d.sphere("eye", 4)
    s3d.material(eye, kind="plastic", color="#000000")
    left_eye = s3d.at(eye, on=head.face("+X"), x=5, y=3)
    right_eye = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(eye), mirror="x")
    
    # Spots (black circles)
    spot = s3d.extrude("spot", s3d.circle(6), 1)
    s3d.material(spot, kind="plastic", color="#000000")
    spot1 = s3d.at(spot, on=body.face("+Y"), x=-10, z=5)
    spot2 = s3d.at(s3d.copy(spot), on=body.face("-Y"), x=-10, z=5)
    spot3 = s3d.at(s3d.copy(spot), on=body.face("+Z"), x=0, z=-10)
    
    # Wings (transparent ovals)
    wing = s3d.extrude("wing", s3d.ellipse(25, 15), 2)
    s3d.material(wing, kind="plastic", color="#ffffff", opacity=0.7)
    left_wing = s3d.at(wing, on=body.face("+Z"), x=5, z=-5, ry=30)
    right_wing = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(left_wing), mirror="x")
    
    # Legs (thin cylinders)
    leg = s3d.cylinder("leg", 1, 10)
    s3d.material(leg, kind="plastic", color="#000000")
    leg1 = s3d.at(leg, on=body.face("-Y"), x=-15, z=10, y=-15)
    leg2 = s3d.at(s3d.copy(leg), on=body.face("-Y"), x=0, z=10, y=-15)
    leg3 = s3d.at(s3d.copy(leg), on=body.face("-Y"), x=15, z=10, y=-15)
    
    return s3d.assembly("ladybug", body, head, left_eye, right_eye, spot1, spot2, spot3, left_wing, right_wing, leg1, leg2, leg3)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    s3d.export(build(), "ladybug.glb")
